guidance: Assuming commodity price remains elevated in H2 also, should we expect similar kind of margins in H2?
So next year, we expect almost another 60% to 80% of growth in terms of export only.
capex: So just wanted to know what's your current capacity utilization of the plant and how we intend to increase that over the next 2 years?
And about capacity utilization, so this year, we are going to achieve around 50%.
risks: Santosh Kumar Yadav: As of now, we don't have any slowdown, particularly in our product.
Obviously, in the short term because of freight cost, etc., we are seeing some pressure on margins for a quarter or 2.
focus: Growth during the first half has been broad-based, coming from new customers, a wider product range, the ramp-up of our new facility and a larger share of business from overseas market.
Customers in North America and Europe are giving us more business, including new customers in the data center space.
So whatever new customer we are onboarding or export increasing, of course, they contribute on a higher EBITDA margin for sure, including export.
